changes: Freeze legacy or guarded query-module identity, preload and seal transitive local imports.
Hash actual dispatch fields including thinking, reasoning effort and output budget; preserve frozen requests and recorded responses.
Enforce a wall-clock deadline before each provider call and retain explicit unknown decisions for exhausted budgets.
Optionally recover bounded exact source dependencies from candidate repository metadata; added complete sources remain a sealed local artifact.
Reuse the existing source-shape round-robin scheduler to allocate failing candidates without positive labels, review labels, model answers or failure-message ranking.
